topography.project_purpose: REX Staking is a multi-chain DeFi protocol that aggregates yield farming, staking, and liquidity provision opportunities. It offers users vaults, pools, and reward mechanisms to earn yield on deposited assets across numerous blockchains.
topography.relationship_narrative: The single product family encompasses all contracts, with core vaults and pools interacting with reward and governance contracts to manage yield distribution. Shared infrastructure includes proxy-based upgradeability (ArcProxy, TransparentUpgradeableProxy) and cross-chain deployment patterns via AutoFarmV2_CrossChain.
